question: For each migration status, show the status, the geometric mean of the migrated instances’ memory (in MB) for migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero (considering only active migrations by excluding statuses accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed), the overall geometric-mean memory across all such active migrations as a benchmark, and categorize each status as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT m.status, i.memory_mb
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')
    AND i.memory_mb > 0
),
per_status AS (
  SELECT status, EXP(AVG(LN(memory_mb))) AS geom_mean
  FROM base
  GROUP BY status
),
overall AS (
  SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(memory_mb))) AS benchmark
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  p.status,
  p.geom_mean,
  o.benchmark,
  CASE
    WHEN p.geom_mean >= o.benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY'
    WHEN p.geom_mean <= o.benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'
  END AS category
FROM per_status p
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY p.status

  SELECT m.status, i.memory_mb
  FROM migrations m

    AND i.memory_mb > 0

  SELECT 
    status,
    EXP(AVG(LN(memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory
  FROM active_migrations
  GROUP BY status

  SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(memory_mb))) AS benchmark_geometric_mean
  FROM active_migrations
)

  sg.status,
  sg.geometric_mean_memory,
  b.benchmark_geometric_mean AS benchmark,

    WHEN sg.geometric_mean_memory < b.benchmark_geometric_mean * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'
  END AS memory_category
FROM status_geomean sg
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
ORDER BY sg.status
